en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a prominent mosque with a large dome, smaller domes, and a distinctive Ottoman minaret. The foreground includes a white wall and some trees. The caption in French identifies the building as 'La Mosquée Aladja Imaret' and mentions its past as 'Ancienne Église de St. Catherine à Salonique.' Additional publisher or location information appears on the left margin and a stamp-like mark and website watermark are visible.
